title: Practice 9: Verbs that take the instrumental

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Много лет Марина занималась ___ (инспекция) состояния домов.
exercises.prompt: For years Marina had been inspecting houses.
exercises.why: «After the verbs командовать and заведовать the units or persons being commanded … are denoted by the instrumental case.» Заниматься, пользоваться, интересоваться take the instrumental too. — DLI, Lessons 30, 65, 99.
